import json, subprocess, sys

CAND = '/workspace/submission/main.py'

def run(lines):
    data = ''.join(json.dumps(l) + '\n' if not isinstance(l, str) else l + '\n' for l in lines)
    r = subprocess.run([sys.executable, '-I', '-B', CAND], input=data, text=True, capture_output=True, timeout=60)
    assert r.returncode == 0, r.stderr
    return [json.loads(x) for x in r.stdout.splitlines()]

def flow(fid, labels, path=('a','b','r'), tmpl='aabbcc0000000000', kinds='KKKDZQTK'):
    return dict(id=fid, path=list(path), labels=list(labels), template=tmpl, kinds=kinds)

CAP3 = {'a':5,'b':5,'r':5}
F1 = flow('f1', [16,20,30])
F2 = flow('f2', [16,40,50])

cases = []

# ---- Case 1: busy / overwrite / enable checks / reset / stale ----
ev = [
    dict(op='put',flow='f1',node='a'),   # ok
    dict(op='put',flow='f1',node='b'),   # ok
    dict(op='put',flow='f1',node='r'),   # ok
    dict(op='enable',flow='f1'),         # ok
    dict(op='put',flow='f2',node='a'),   # busy (f1 enabled at (a,16))
    dict(op='put',flow='f2',node='b'),   # ok (label 40 fresh)
    dict(op='put',flow='f2',node='r'),   # ok
    dict(op='enable',flow='f2'),         # unready (a missing)
    dict(op='disable',flow='f1'),        # ok
    dict(op='put',flow='f2',node='a'),   # ok overwrite inactive
    dict(op='enable',flow='f2'),         # ok
    dict(op='enable',flow='f1'),         # unready (a now f2)
    dict(op='packet',flow='f1',header='aabbcc77ee030900',payload='ff'),  # ip/disabled
    dict(op='packet',flow='f2',header='aabbcc77ee030900',payload='ff'),  # mpls
    dict(op='reset'),                    # ok
    dict(op='packet',flow='f2',header='aabbcc77ee030900',payload='ff'),  # ip/disabled
    dict(op='enable',flow='f1'),         # unready (a missing)
]
req = dict(mode='replay', capacities=CAP3, flows=[F1,F2], events=ev)
exp = dict(results=[
    {'status':s} for s in ['ok','ok','ok','ok','busy','ok','ok','unready','ok','ok','ok','unready']
] + [
    dict(mode='ip',reason='disabled',wire=['aabbcc77ee030900ff','aabbcc77ee030800ff','aabbcc77ee030700ff'],
         delivered='aabbcc77ee030700ff',byte_hops=27),
    dict(mode='mpls',reason='compressed',wire=['0001070977ff','0002870877ff','0003270777ff'],
         delivered='aabbcc7700030700ff',byte_hops=18),
    {'status':'ok'},
    dict(mode='ip',reason='disabled',wire=['aabbcc77ee030900ff','aabbcc77ee030800ff','aabbcc77ee030700ff'],
         delivered='aabbcc77ee030700ff',byte_hops=27),
    {'status':'unready'},
], active=[], tables=[
    dict(node='a',label=16,flow='f2'), dict(node='b',label=20,flow='f1'),
    dict(node='b',label=40,flow='f2'), dict(node='r',label=30,flow='f1'),
    dict(node='r',label=50,flow='f2')])
cases.append(('busy-overwrite-reset', [req], [exp]))

# ---- Case 2: full / idempotent put ----
ev = [
    dict(op='put',flow='f1',node='a'),
    dict(op='put',flow='f2',node='a'),   # full (cap 1, label 60 absent)
    dict(op='put',flow='f2',node='a'),   # full
    dict(op='put',flow='f1',node='a'),   # idempotent ok
    dict(op='put',flow='f1',node='b'),
    dict(op='put',flow='f1',node='r'),
    dict(op='enable',flow='f1'),         # ok
    dict(op='put',flow='f1',node='a'),   # idempotent ok while enabled
    dict(op='put',flow='f1',node='b'),   # idempotent ok while enabled
]
F2b = flow('f2', [60,40,50])
req = dict(mode='replay', capacities={'a':1,'b':1,'r':1}, flows=[F1,F2b], events=ev)
exp = dict(results=[{'status':s} for s in ['ok','full','full','ok','ok','ok','ok','ok','ok']],
           active=['f1'], tables=[dict(node='a',label=16,flow='f1'),dict(node='b',label=20,flow='f1'),dict(node='r',label=30,flow='f1')])
cases.append(('full-idempotent', [req], [exp]))

# ---- Case 3: classification order + TTL ladder ----
ev = [
    dict(op='put',flow='f1',node='a'), dict(op='put',flow='f1',node='b'),
    dict(op='put',flow='f1',node='r'), dict(op='enable',flow='f1'),
    dict(op='packet',flow='f1',header='aabbcd77ee080900',payload=''),   # mismatch beats qos
    dict(op='packet',flow='f1',header='aabbcc77ee080900',payload=''),   # qos
    dict(op='packet',flow='f1',header='aabbcc77ee030000',payload='ff'), # T=0 no wire
    dict(op='packet',flow='f1',header='aabbcc77ee030100',payload='ff'), # 1 hop, drop at a
    dict(op='packet',flow='f1',header='aabbcc77ee030200',payload='ff'), # 2 hops, drop at b
    dict(op='packet',flow='f1',header='aabbcc77ee030300',payload='ff'), # delivered, final ttl 1
]
req = dict(mode='replay', capacities=CAP3, flows=[F1], events=ev)
exp = dict(results=[
    {'status':s} for s in ['ok','ok','ok','ok']
] + [
    dict(mode='ip',reason='mismatch',wire=['aabbcd77ee080900','aabbcd77ee080800','aabbcd77ee080700'],
         delivered='aabbcd77ee080700',byte_hops=27),
    dict(mode='ip',reason='qos',wire=['aabbcc77ee080900','aabbcc77ee080800','aabbcc77ee080700'],
         delivered='aabbcc77ee080700',byte_hops=27),
    dict(mode='mpls',reason='compressed',wire=[],delivered=None,byte_hops=0),
    dict(mode='mpls',reason='compressed',wire=['0001070177ff'],delivered=None,byte_hops=6),
    dict(mode='mpls',reason='compressed',wire=['0001070277ff','0001470177ff'],delivered=None,byte_hops=12),
    dict(mode='mpls',reason='compressed',wire=['0001070377ff','0001470277ff','0001e70177ff'],
         delivered='aabbcc7700030100ff',byte_hops=18),
], active=['f1'], tables=[dict(node='a',label=16,flow='f1'),dict(node='b',label=20,flow='f1'),dict(node='r',label=30,flow='f1')])
cases.append(('classify-ttl', [req], [exp]))

# ---- Case 4: label coincidence; inactive overwrite at every node ----
ev = [
    dict(op='put',flow='f1',node='a'), dict(op='put',flow='f1',node='b'), dict(op='put',flow='f1',node='r'),
    dict(op='put',flow='f2',node='a'), dict(op='put',flow='f2',node='b'), dict(op='put',flow='f2',node='r'),
]
F2c = flow('f2', [16,20,30])
req = dict(mode='replay', capacities=CAP3, flows=[F1,F2c], events=ev)
exp = dict(results=[{'status':s} for s in ['ok']*6], active=[],
           tables=[dict(node='a',label=16,flow='f2'),dict(node='b',label=20,flow='f2'),dict(node='r',label=30,flow='f2')])
cases.append(('label-reuse-overwrite', [req], [exp]))

# ---- Case 5: IP fallback with odd Z/Q received values; multi-D residue order ----
Fd = flow('fd', [16,20,30], path=('s0','s1','s2','r'), tmpl='001122334455667788', kinds='KDDKZDZQT')
# H=9: K at 0,3,7 ; D at 1,2,5 ; Z at 4,6 ; Q at 8? wait kinds has 9 chars: K D D K Z D Z Q T -> Q idx7? let me recount
# kinds='KDDKZDZQT' -> idx: 0 K,1 D,2 D,3 K,4 Z,5 D,6 Z,7 Q,8 T  (Q once, T once, K=2, D=3 -> 4+3=7<9 ok)
ev = [
    dict(op='put',flow='fd',node='s0'), dict(op='put',flow='fd',node='s1'),
    dict(op='put',flow='fd',node='s2'), dict(op='put',flow='fd',node='r'),
    dict(op='enable',flow='fd'),
    # header: K must match tmpl bytes 0,3,7 = 00,33,88 ; Q at idx7?? careful: Q is at idx 7 = '88' pos
    # positions: 0 K,1 D,2 D,3 K,4 Z,5 D,6 Z,7 Q,8 T
    # header bytes: 00 aa bb 33 cc dd ee 05 0a  -> K: 00==00,33==33 ; Q byte7=05<=7 ; T byte8=0a
    dict(op='packet',flow='fd',header='00aabb33ccddee050a',payload='cafe'),
]
req = dict(mode='replay', capacities={'s0':3,'s1':3,'s2':3,'r':3}, flows=[Fd], events=ev)
# residue = D bytes in order idx1,2,5 = aa bb dd
# links: labels [16,20,30,16]; N=4; word=(lbl<<12)|(5<<9)|(1<<8)|ttl
# link0 lbl16 ttl10: (16<<12)|(5<<9)|0x100|10 = 0x10000|0xa00|0x100|0xa = 0x00010b0a
# link1 lbl20 ttl9 : 0x14000|0xa00|0x100|9 = 0x00014b09
# link2 lbl30 ttl8 : 0x1e000|0xa00|0x100|8 = 0x0001eb08
# link3 lbl16 ttl7 : 0x00010b07
# delivered: K:0=00,3=33,7=Q=05 ; D:1=aa,2=bb,5=dd ; Z:4=0,6=0 ; Q idx7=05 ; T=7
# -> 00 aa bb 33 00 dd 00 05 07 + cafe
exp = dict(results=[{'status':s} for s in ['ok']*5] + [
    dict(mode='mpls',reason='compressed',
         wire=['00010b0aaabbddcafe','00014b09aabbddcafe','0001eb08aabbddcafe','00010b07aabbddcafe'],
         delivered='00aabb3300dd000507cafe',byte_hops=44),
], active=['fd'], tables=[
    dict(node='r',label=16,flow='fd'),dict(node='s0',label=16,flow='fd'),
    dict(node='s1',label=20,flow='fd'),dict(node='s2',label=30,flow='fd')])
cases.append(('mpls-multid', [req], [exp]))

# IP fallback: same flow disabled -> Z and Q as received, T updated
req2 = dict(mode='replay', capacities={'s0':3,'s1':3,'s2':3,'r':3}, flows=[Fd], events=[
    dict(op='packet',flow='fd',header='00aabb33ccddee050a',payload='cafe')])
exp2 = dict(results=[
    dict(mode='ip',reason='disabled',
         wire=['00aabb33ccddee050acafe','00aabb33ccddee040acafe','00aabb33ccddee030acafe','00aabb33ccddee020acafe'],
         delivered='00aabb33ccddee020acafe',byte_hops=48),
], active=[], tables=[])
cases.append(('ip-multid', [req2], [exp2]))

# ---- Case 6: enable an already-enabled flow is ok even after label steal attempt blocked ----
ev = [
    dict(op='put',flow='f1',node='a'), dict(op='put',flow='f1',node='b'), dict(op='put',flow='f1',node='r'),
    dict(op='enable',flow='f1'), dict(op='enable',flow='f1'),
    dict(op='disable',flow='f1'), dict(op='disable',flow='f1'),  # double disable ok
    dict(op='enable',flow='f1'),
]
req = dict(mode='replay', capacities=CAP3, flows=[F1], events=ev)
exp = dict(results=[{'status':s} for s in ['ok']*8], active=['f1'],
           tables=[dict(node='a',label=16,flow='f1'),dict(node='b',label=20,flow='f1'),dict(node='r',label=30,flow='f1')])
cases.append(('enable-twice', [req], [exp]))

# ---- Case 7: error inputs ----
bad = [
    '',
    '{',
    '[]',
    'null',
    '5',
    '{"mode":"replay","capacities":{"a":1,"b":1,"r":1},"flows":[],"events":[],}',
    '{"mode":"replay","mode":"plan","capacities":{"a":1},"flows":[],"events":[]}',
    '{"mode":"plan","capacities":{"a":1},"flows":[],"events":[]}',
    '{"mode":"replay","capacities":{},"flows":[],"events":[]}',
    '{"mode":"replay","capacities":{"a":true},"flows":[],"events":[]}',
    '{"mode":"replay","capacities":{"a":513},"flows":[],"events":[]}',
    '{"mode":"replay","capacities":{"bad id":1},"flows":[],"events":[]}',
    '{"mode":"replay","capacities":{"a":NaN},"flows":[],"events":[]}',
    '{"mode":"replay","capacities":{"a":Infinity},"flows":[],"events":[]}',
    '{"mode":"replay","capacities":{"a":1.5},"flows":[],"events":[]}',
    json.dumps(dict(mode='replay',capacities=CAP3,flows=[dict(F1,labels=[16,20])],events=[])),
    json.dumps(dict(mode='replay',capacities=CAP3,flows=[dict(F1,labels=[16,20,15])],events=[])),
    json.dumps(dict(mode='replay',capacities=CAP3,flows=[dict(F1,template='aabbcc00000000')],events=[])),
    json.dumps(dict(mode='replay',capacities=CAP3,flows=[dict(F1,template='AABBCC0000000000')],events=[])),
    json.dumps(dict(mode='replay',capacities=CAP3,flows=[dict(F1,kinds='KKKDZQT')],events=[])),
    json.dumps(dict(mode='replay',capacities=CAP3,flows=[dict(F1,kinds='KKKDZQQK')],events=[])),
    json.dumps(dict(mode='replay',capacities=CAP3,flows=[dict(F1,kinds='DDDDZQTK')],events=[])),
    json.dumps(dict(mode='replay',capacities=CAP3,flows=[dict(F1,path=['a','a','r'])],events=[])),
    json.dumps(dict(mode='replay',capacities=CAP3,flows=[dict(F1,path=['a','x','r'])],events=[])),
    json.dumps(dict(mode='replay',capacities=CAP3,flows=[dict(F1,path=['a','r'])],events=[])),
    json.dumps(dict(mode='replay',capacities=CAP3,flows=[F1,F1],events=[])),
    json.dumps(dict(mode='replay',capacities=CAP3,flows=[F1],events=[dict(op='put',flow='f1',node='x')])),
    json.dumps(dict(mode='replay',capacities=CAP3,flows=[F1],events=[dict(op='put',flow='zz',node='a')])),
    json.dumps(dict(mode='replay',capacities=CAP3,flows=[F1],events=[dict(op='packet',flow='f1',header='aabbcc',payload='')])),
    json.dumps(dict(mode='replay',capacities=CAP3,flows=[F1],events=[dict(op='packet',flow='f1',header='aabbcc0000000000',payload='f')])),
    json.dumps(dict(mode='replay',capacities=CAP3,flows=[F1],events=[dict(op='bogus',flow='f1')])),
    json.dumps(dict(mode='replay',capacities=CAP3,flows=[F1],events=[dict(op='reset',flow='f1')])),
    json.dumps(dict(mode='replay',capacities=CAP3,flows=[F1],events=[dict(op='enable')])),
    '{"mode":"replay","capacities":{"a":1},"flows":[],"events":[],"extra":1}',
    '{"mode":"plan","capacities":{"a":1},"flows":[],"warmup":0,"pinned":[],"offers":{},"labels":[]}',
    json.dumps(dict(mode='plan',capacities=CAP3,flows=[dict(F1,labels=[16,20,30])],warmup=0,pinned=[],offers={'f1':[]})),
    json.dumps(dict(mode='plan',capacities=CAP3,flows=[F1],warmup=-1,pinned=[],offers={'f1':[]})),
    json.dumps(dict(mode='plan',capacities=CAP3,flows=[F1],warmup=0,pinned=['nope'],offers={'f1':[]})),

    json.dumps(dict(mode='plan',capacities=CAP3,flows=[F1],warmup=0,pinned=[],offers={})),
    json.dumps(dict(mode='plan',capacities=CAP3,flows=[F1],warmup=0,pinned=[],offers={'f1':[dict(header='aabbcc0000000000',count=0)]})),
    json.dumps(dict(mode='plan',capacities=CAP3,flows=[F1],warmup=0,pinned=[],offers={'f1':[dict(header='aabbcc0000000000',count=1,extra=2)]})),
    json.dumps(dict(mode='plan',capacities=CAP3,flows=[F1],warmup=0,pinned=[],offers={'f1':[dict(header='aabbcc',count=1)]})),

nbad = 0
for i, (b, g) in enumerate(zip(bad, got)):
    if g != {'error':'input'}:
        nbad += 1
        print('NOT-ERROR', i, b[:100], '->', g)
print('bad-input cases:', len(bad), 'non-error:', nbad)

# valid sanity: KDDDZQTK is valid (4+3<8)
g = run([json.dumps(dict(mode='replay',capacities=CAP3,flows=[dict(F1,kinds='KDDDZQTK')],events=[]))])[0]

            print('FAIL', name, i)
